agent 0.2.0-alpha.5 — Git-native consistency manager for AI-agent skills.

Usage:
  agent <command> [options]
  git agent <command> [options]   (via the git-agent extension)

Commands:
  init                Scaffold .agent/ and .githooks/ (use --force to overwrite).
  status              Report Agent Sync state and drift (--json, --fail-on-drift, --ci).
  sync                Write missing/outdated projections (--check, --write, --force, --json).
  diff                Show canonical-to-projection differences (--json).
  validate            Validate config and skills (--json).
  import skill        Import a SKILL.md/skill folder into .agent/skills (--id, --name, --target, --dry-run, --force, --json).
  import agent        Import an existing instruction file/folder (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor, ...) (--type, --split, --id, --dry-run, --force, --json).
  import subagent     Import existing sub-agent files (.claude/agents/*.md) into .agent/agents (--id, --dry-run, --force, --json).
  skill               Manage canonical skills: add | edit | delete | list | show.
  target              Manage projection targets: add | edit | delete | list | show.
  subagent            Manage canonical sub-agents: add | edit | delete | list | show.
  sessions            Back up / restore agent session history: backup | restore | list | providers.
  ui                  Launch the optional local web UI (separate install; CLI stays GUI-free) (--no-open).
  install-hooks       Configure core.hooksPath and make hooks executable.
  doctor              Diagnose Git repo, PATH, hooks, and config (--json).

Global:
  --version, -v       Print version.
  --help, -h          Print this help.
